events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Poised To Open To The Upside
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished lower in five straight sessions, sinking almost 925 points or 3.9 percent in that span. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 22,380-point plateau although it may halt its slide on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Sharply Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is sharply higher on Tuesday, snapping an eight-session losing streak, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving up to near the 8,700 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May See Additional Support On Tuesday
events.description: The China stock market on Monday snapped the two-day slide in which it had fallen more than 50 points or 1.4 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,540-point plateau and it may extend its gains on Tuesday.

events.title: Tech Shares Likely To Extend Taiwan Stock Market Recovery
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Monday ended the brutal two-day slide in which it had crashed more than 4,150 points or 10.3 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 36,810-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Tuesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market Tipped To Open In The Green
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, sinking more than 125 points or 2.5 percent in that span. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 4,950-point plateau although it may find traction on Tuesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Halt Its Slide On Tuesday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has tracked lower in five straight sessions, sinking almost 40 points or 2.4 percent along the way. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just beneath the 1,550-point plateau although it's expected to find support on Tuesday.

events.title: Rebound Anticipated For Japan Stock Market
events.description: Ahead of Monday's holiday for Labor Thanksgiving Day, the Japan stock market had halted the two-day winning streak in which it had advanced more than 580 points or 1 percent. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 56,430-point plateau although it figures to bounce higher again on Tuesday.

events.title: KOSPI Poised To End Losing Streak
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, plunging almost 430 points or 8 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 4,710-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Tuesday.

events.title: Japan PMI Data Due On Tuesday
events.description: Japan will on Tuesday see preliminary November results for its manufacturing, services and composite PMIs from S&P Global, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances As Traders Assess Trump's Remarks On Iran
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Monday as investors parsed U.S. President Donald Trump's remarks that he may be inclined to order strikes against Iran after the new year if both the nations fail to reach an agreement by that time.

events.title: Swiss Market Snaps 4-day Losing Streak, Ends On Bright Note
events.description: The Swiss market started off on a somewhat sluggish note on Monday, but edged up gradually and after moving in a narrow range till well past mid afternoon, gained in strength and ended the session on a strong note as buying gathered momentum in the final hour.

events.title: European Markets Close Strong On NVIDIA CEO Return; Tech Sector Leads Rally
events.description: European stocks surged Monday after a five-session losing streak, with the Stoxx 600 climbing 1.81% following NVIDIA's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive. Tech stocks led gains amid AI optimism, while mining and defense sectors also advanced.

events.title: TSX Surges 3% As Stocks Rally On NVIDIA CEO Reinstatement
events.description: The S&P/TSX Composite Index rose more than 3% Monday as technology stocks advanced following NVIDIA's decision to reinstate founder Jensen Huang as President and CEO, while materials rallied on rising precious metals prices.
